summary: Obfuscated mass-mailing / SMTP-credential-cracking / phishing operator toolkit
details: Package publishes as `monogrok` with homepage `https://mntmc.rip` and ships ~250 heavily obfuscated JavaScript files (RC4+base64 string-array scheme) across `cmds/`, `func/`, and `utils/` implementing a full commercial mass-mailing, SMTP-credential-hunting, and phishing toolkit. Bundled `_init/` templates include Shodan queries targeting AWS SES / SendGrid / Mailgun / Postmark endpoints, cookie-file layouts for Outlook/Gmail sessions, phishing link templates with `[[-EMAIL-]]` / `[[-BASE64_EMAIL-]]` tracking substitutions, LinkedIn / Crunchbase / Alibaba data-extractors, and Telegram/Discord webhook exfil sinks for cracked-credential delivery to the operator. `package.json` declares no install lifecycle scripts (no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare) and exposes a `preferGlobal` commander CLI entry (`oibWljdTg.js`); the abusive behavior fires only when an operator explicitly runs the CLI, not on `npm install` or `require()`. Under this system's threat model the victims are third parties — owners of cracked SMTP accounts and phishing recipients — not the developer installing the package. The obfuscation across the entire codebase prevents transparent auditing of any inbound-to-installer behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
